title: Make /review-changes' round-keyed reviewer limits and fix-round scope match the family split
outcome: Make /review-changes' round-keyed reviewer limits and fix-round scope match the family split
acceptance: Under a family split, /review-changes applies its limits on a round's counting reviews and on the Kimi stand-in to each family's pair (today: 'a round never has more than two reviews that count', 'Kimi never stands in for both reviewers of the same round', 'if no stand-in has been spawned this round')
/review-changes section 4's fix-round paragraph says that under a family split each family's pair reviews its whole family, matching the AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md Fix-rounds bullet
The seam family's brief names the cross-family interfaces it covers, and its pair may read any path to judge them
